scope: Local native DATA-ONLY comparisons of already completed authorized remote prechecks
cmd:
set -e
export LC_ALL=C
sort -z pre-source17-regular-paths.stdout > pre-source17-regular-paths.sorted.nul
cmp ../c4-support-proposal-v1/ledgers/source-files.nul pre-source17-regular-paths.sorted.nul
sort -z pre-source17-file-modes-size-links.stdout > pre-source17-file-modes-size-links.sorted.nul
cmp ../c4-support-proposal-v1/ledgers/source-file-modes.nul pre-source17-file-modes-size-links.sorted.nul
sort -z pre-source17-directory-modes.stdout > pre-source17-directory-modes.sorted.nul
cmp ../c4-support-proposal-v1/ledgers/source-directory-modes.nul pre-source17-directory-modes.sorted.nul
test ! -s pre-source17-nonregular.stdout
cmp expected-tool-guidance.sha256 pre-tool-license-guidance-pins.stdout
cmp expected-normal-reference.sha256 pre-normal-source-manifest-and-NUL-reference-pins.stdout
sort pre-full-toolchain-regular-hashes.stdout > pre-full-toolchain-regular-hashes.sorted.txt
cmp ../support-tool-stage-v3/pre-toolchain-files.stdout.sorted pre-full-toolchain-regular-hashes.sorted.txt
sort -z pre-full-toolchain-symlink-targets.stdout > pre-full-toolchain-symlink-targets.sorted.nul
cmp ../support-tool-stage-v3/pre-toolchain-symlinks.stdout.sorted pre-full-toolchain-symlink-targets.sorted.nul
cmp ../support-tool-stage-v3/pre-toolchain-version.stdout pre-official-clang-version.stdout
printf '%s  %s\n' '0b8b569da3c794f6295aa4556544c63de83ac1f43ecf36f0f8bcf81955d736cc' '/home/david/buster-fast-bench/codex-883-qualification-ce1-cecd-hot-v4/manifests/producer.sha256' | cmp - pre-source17-manifest-pin.stdout
head -n 1 pre-actual-exclusive-context.stdout | rg --fixed-strings --line-regexp 1
rg --fixed-strings --quiet 'codex-883-qualification-ce1-cecd-hot-v4' pre-actual-owned-lock-file.stdout
rg --fixed-strings --quiet '/home/david/buster-fast-bench/codex-883-qualification-ce1-cecd-hot-v4/bin/hp_method' output-absent-before-sole-build.stderr
rg --fixed-strings --quiet 'No such file or directory' output-absent-before-sole-build.stderr
test ! -s output-absent-before-sole-build.stdout
wc -l pre-full-toolchain-regular-hashes.sorted.txt
tr '\0' '\n' < pre-full-toolchain-symlink-targets.sorted.nul | wc -l
